FedEx (FDX) said the Form 10 registration for FedEx Freight is effective, removing a regulatory hurdle that could presage a carve‑out or other structural change in logistics and valuation models. Energy, Hydrogen & Clean Tech Plug Power (PLUG) posted Q1 results with 22% revenue growth and a 71% margin improvement year‑over‑year—evidence margins can move quickly as scale comes to hydrogen businesses. Microvast (MVST) released first‑quarter results, adding fresh capacity, backlog and margin data for investors gauging EV‑battery supply chain economics. Tech, AI & Infrastructure Brookfield (BAM) will invest $500 million in a strategic partnership with OpenAI, a notable bridge between real assets and AI infrastructure that could accelerate hyperscale data‑center builds. CI&T (CINT) reported 23.2% organic revenue growth in Q1, illustrating enterprise demand for AI services beyond the hyperscalers. Elastic (ESTC) introduced Jina v5 Omni, new multimodal models that underscore retrieval and vector search as core plumbing for enterprise AI. Enterprise Software & Security F5 (FFIV) expanded collaboration with Red Hat to strengthen Kubernetes and AI application security—important as containerized stacks drive cloud‑native spend. Check Point Software (CHKP) announced a $2.0 billion expansion of its share‑repurchase authorization, a capital‑allocation move that can support EPS and signals board confidence in cash generation. Financials & Capital Markets Global Payments (GPN) struck an exclusive payments agreement with CKE Restaurants, a merchant win that may lift transaction volumes and recurring revenue for processors. Visa (V) announced the expiration and results of its exchange offer for dual‑class shares, a governance development investors watch for long‑term voting‑structure implications. BMO (BMO) is selling its transportation and vendor finance businesses, with Stonepeak named as the buyer, a deal that reshapes asset‑finance exposure and could free capital for core banking priorities. Encore Capital Group (ECPG) announced the pricing of an upsized senior secured notes offering, a financing move that adjusts leverage and liquidity posture for a consumer‑debt servicer navigating a higher‑rate environment. Alignment Healthcare (ALGT) is set to join the S&P SmallCap 600, a likely boost to passive flows and index‑tracker demand following the inclusion. Consumer, Media & Retail Victoria’s Secret & Co. (VSCO) filed a supplement to its definitive proxy statement and sent a shareholder letter, reinforcing its outperformance case amid potential governance pressure. BuzzFeed, Inc. (BZFD) unveiled a proposed majority‑stake investment by Byron Allen’s family office, a potentially transformational deal that could reshape content strategy and monetization. Transport, Mobility & Aerospace Archer (ACHR) reported Q1 results and highlighted record FAA certification progress, keeping timelines and commercialization risks front of mind for eVTOL investors. RTX (RTX)'s Collins Aerospace is accelerating production with a $26.5 million investment in Largo, Florida, a supplier‑level signal for defense and aerospace revenue visibility. Defense, Space & EV Infrastructure Xos (XOS) landed a contract to bring mobile EV charging to the U.S. Air Force, expanding electric‑fleet tech into defense logistics and underscoring government demand for resilient charging infrastructure. Healthcare & Biotech Alpha Tau (DRTS) reported striking interim glioblastoma data—100% local control, 67% complete response—results that, if validated, could materially shift clinical and valuation assumptions in radiotherapy oncology.
